identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of WVE-004 in Patients With C9orf72-associated Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) or Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Phase 1b/2a Study of WVE-004 Administered Intrathecally to Patients With C9orf72-associated Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) or Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD)

statusModule.whyStopped: Despite robust, sustained reductions in poly(GP), no clinical benefit was seen at 24 weeks, and reductions in poly(GP) were not associated with stabilization in functional outcomes. Based on these data, Wave decided to stop development of WVE-004.
